claim_scope: Records, per paper, whether its science is complete enough that a content binding taken now would survive. Not a readiness verdict in either direction: PENDING_SCIENCE__DO_NOT_BIND says a byte freeze would be invalidated by work already in flight, and says nothing about the quality or validity of any claim.
decision_rule: A paper is SCIENCE_COMPLETE__BINDABLE only if no open task, adverse terminal, or running acquisition can still change its bytes. Ambiguity resolves to PENDING, because a wrong BINDABLE produces a freeze that silently stops describing the paper while a wrong PENDING only delays one.
